title: MLA Style — In-Text Citations (8th Ed., 2016)
skills: identify the basic purpose of MLA in-text citations
integrate quotations and paraphrases with source attribution
connect in-text citations to corresponding source entries
recognize citation practices that remain foundational across MLA editions
alignment_note: Provides instruction on MLA in-text citations using the 8th edition framework. Many foundational citation principles remain useful, but this is a legacy MLA edition and current coursework should verify formatting details against MLA 9th edition guidance.
